table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Godown = Godown.Name,
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.purprice,   
	Item.PackUnits,   
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
	Manufacturer.name,
	classname=itemclass.name,
	Category=itemcategory.name,
	UnitPrice = 
	Case :ai_pricetype 
		WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
	END ,
	PackQty =convert(int,isnull( Round(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),0)),
	
	looseqqty=isnull( Round(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)) % Item.packUnits, 2),0),
	StockValue = isnull(Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) *
	Case :ai_pricetype 
		WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
	END
	
FROM 
	Godown, 
	Manufacturer,   
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode=itemclass.iccode),
	ItemCategory
	
WHERE 
	( Godown.GCode IN (:ai_gcode)) AND
	( GodownDetail.GCode = Godown.GCode ) and
	( Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode ) and  
	( Item.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode ) ) and
	( Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode ) and
	( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
	( Item.active=1)
	
GROUP BY 
	Godown.Name,
	Item.name, 
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active,
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.PackUnits, 
	Manufacturer.name,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name
table.sort: godown A, manufacturer_name A, item_name A
